name: Attendance
description: Attendance, tasks and end-of-day reports in a side panel. Talks to the attendance bot; the /att commands keep working.

settings_schema.header: Connects this plugin to the attendance bot. Both must use the same secret.

settings.help_text: Where the plugin reaches the attendance bot on the internal Docker network.
The same value as PLUGIN_SECRET in the bot's .env. Requests between the plugin and the bot are refused without it.
